description_en: Queries the transaction details of a fund account
description_zh: 查询资金账户收支明细
kebab_example: aliyun bssopenapi get-fund-account-transaction-details --fund-account-id 123221232 --transaction-number 543231231 --bill-number 2023212312321 --channel-transaction-number 20250312334312322 --start-time 1735664461000 --end-time 1735664561000 --transaction-direction IN --transaction-type CHARGE --transaction-type-list CHARGE --transaction-channel-list ACCT_CASH --current-page 1 --page-size 20 --api-version 2023-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetFundAccountTransactionDetails

parameters.help_en: The ID of the fund account. If you do not specify this parameter, the ID of the account owned by the current user is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 资金账户id，不传时默认使用当前账号拥有（owner）的账户id
parameters.name: fund_account_id

parameters.help_en: The start timestamp for the query. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end timestamp for the query. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_zh: 交易方向 in/out(资金流入流出)
parameters.name: transaction_direction

parameters.help_en:
The transaction type. If you specify a transaction type, the query returns results of the corresponding type. If no results exist, an empty result is returned. If you do not specify this parameter, all types are returned by default. Valid values:
CHARGE: Top-up.
WITHDRAW: Withdrawal.
REFUND: Refund.
PAY: Payment.
TRANSFER: Transfer.
ADJUST: Adjustment.
PAY_FAILED: Refund for failed order
parameters.help_zh:
交易类型。 传入以下交易类型，查询返回对应类型结果，不存在时结果为空。不传默认返回所有类型。

充值：CHARGE。

提现：WITHDRAW。

退款：REFUND。

消费：PAY。

转账：TRANSFER。

调账：ADJUST。

订单失效退款: PAY_FAILED
parameters.name: transaction_type

parameters.help_en: The list of transaction types. You can specify multiple parameters for a parameter query
parameters.help_zh: 交易类型列表，支持多个参数查询
parameters.name: transaction_type_list

parameters.help_en:
The list of transaction channels. If you specify this parameter, transactions are queried by channel. If you do not specify this parameter, all channels are queried by default. Valid values:
ACCT_CASH: User balance.
ALIPAY: Alipay.
ALIPAY_ZHIFUTONG: Alipay Zhifutong.
OFFLINE_REMIT: Corporate remittance.
REFUND: Credit limit refund.
UNION_PAY_BANK: Online banking.
CREDIT_CARD: Credit card. Available only on the international site.
AYPAL: PayPal. Available only on the international site
parameters.help_zh:
交易渠道，传入时按交易渠道查询，不传时默认查所有。

用户余额：ACCT_CASH。

支付宝：ALIPAY。

支付宝支付通：ALIPAY_ZHIFUTONG。

对公汇款：OFFLINE_REMIT。

信控额度退款：REFUND。

网银：UNION_PAY_BANK。

信用卡：CREDIT_CARD。（国际站才有）

AYPAL：PAYPAL 。（国际站才有）
parameters.name: transaction_channel_list

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 200
parameters.name: page_size
